jd_text:
Registered Nurse – Medical Intensive Care Unit (MICU), Nights
Lakemont General Hospital | Columbus, OH
Full-time, 36 hours/week (3 x 12-hour night shifts, 7p–7a) | Every third weekend
Sign-on bonus: up to $10,000 for experienced RNs

Position Summary
Lakemont General is a 410-bed Level II trauma center. Our 24-bed Medical ICU cares for critically ill adults with sepsis, respiratory failure, GI bleeds, DKA and multi-organ failure. Staffing is 1:2, or 1:1 for unstable patients and patients on CRRT. You'll have a 12-week orientation with a dedicated ICU preceptor, plus our critical care course.

Key Responsibilities
- Assess, plan, deliver and evaluate care for 1–2 critically ill patients per shift
- Titrate vasoactive, sedation and insulin drips per protocol
- Care for patients on mechanical ventilation in partnership with respiratory therapy
- Monitor arterial lines, central lines and hemodynamic values
- Respond to codes and rapid responses across the hospital as part of the ICU team
- Educate patients and families, and support families through end-of-life decisions
- Document assessments and interventions in Epic
- Take charge nurse shifts once you're eligible under our clinical ladder

Qualifications
Required:
- Current Ohio RN license or multistate compact license
- BSN from an accredited nursing program
- 2+ years of acute care RN experience (ICU, step-down or ED strongly preferred)
- BLS and ACLS from the American Heart Association, current at hire
- CCRN certification (AACN), current at hire

Preferred:
- 1+ year of ICU experience
- Experience with CRRT, arterial lines and vasoactive titration
- NIHSS certification
- Experience precepting new graduate nurses
- Super-user experience with Epic

What We Offer
- Night differential of $5/hour and weekend differential of $3/hour
- Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 a year, plus CCRN exam and renewal reimbursement
- Medical, dental and vision coverage starting day one
- 403(b) with up to 5% employer match
- Clinical ladder with pay increases at each level
- Free parking and on-site childcare (waitlist)

Lakemont General Hospital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other status protected by law. Lakemont General is a drug-free and tobacco-free workplace; offers are contingent on a background check and drug screen.

expectations.trap_notes: Floating to step-down about twice a month and a step-down practicum are not ICU experience: don't write 'ICU experience', 'critical care experience' or 'MICU'. Relief charge 1–2 shifts a month must not become 'Charge Nurse'. Nothing in the profile shows vasoactive drip titration, mechanical ventilation, arterial lines or CRRT. Don't round 3 years up. The certification gap can appear only as a plan the user confirms (e.g. a planned exam date), never as held.
